channel.title: Updates on Subhrajit Das
channel.description: Recent content in Updates on Subhrajit Das

item.title: DigitsOnTurbo @ ASPLOS 2027!!!
item.description: Our work, “DigitsOnTurbo: Leveraging SIMD for Accelerating Large-number Arithmetic”, has been accepted to the 32nd ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS) 2027, which will be held in Heraklion, Crete, Greece, in April 2027.

item.title: CFC @ IICT Workshop 2026
item.description: Our work, “Complementary Function Co-scheduling Across Call Boundaries”, has been accepted as a poster at Innovations in Compiler Technology (IICT) Workshop 2026, which will be held at IISc Bengaluru, India, in October 2026.

item.title: Attended AsiaCCS 2026 in Bengaluru, India
item.description: I attended the AsiaCCS 2026 in Bengaluru, India from 01-05 June 2026, where I had been a volunteer. It was a great experience to attend a flagship security conference in India and interact with the attendees.

item.title: Presented poster @ AI Day 2026, IITGn
item.description: I attended the AI Day 2026 at IIT Gandhinagar on 12th February 2026, where I had presented a poster for our work “Davids vs. Goliath — Achieving GPU-like performance using Network of Stations”.

item.title: Presented Poster at IISc Bangalore
item.description: Presented poster on our work on “Accelerating Large Integer Arithmetic with Parallel Addition, Subtraction, and Vedic-Based Multiplication Using AVX512” at the Computer Systems Workshop held at IISc Bangalore.

item.title: Organized Cyber Security CTF at ICAN FDP, IIT Madras
item.description: Organized web security CTFs for ICAN Faculty Development Program on Cybersecurity at IIT Madras.

item.title: Director's PhD Fellowship
item.description: Selected for the Director’s PhD Fellowship at the IIT Gandhinagar.

item.title: Best Paper Award at BuildSEC'24
item.description: Attended BuildSEC'24 in New Delhi and presented our work on “Online Authentication Habits of Indian Users”. We also won the Best Paper Award there!
